cards.in_the_file: This road is ours today, my loves. Five batteries a head, or ten for all of you because you dress so ugly I feel sorry. Rick Owens would cry.
cards.line: This road is ours today, my loves. Five batteries a head, or ten for all of you because you dress so ugly I feel sorry. Rick Owens would cry.

cards.in_the_file: The water is running! My whole street drinks again, and nobody pays him for it.
cards.line: The water is running! My whole street drinks again, and nobody pays him for it.

cards.in_the_file: {name} didn't get up, carnal. He's gone.
cards.line: TEO didn't get up, carnal. He's gone.

cards.in_the_file: There it is. You see what you get, no surprises. Win and you get paid. Lose and you feed them.
cards.line: There it is. You see what you get, no surprises. Win and you get paid. Lose and you feed them.

cards.in_the_file: Watch meeting at the circle at the end of the street. Bring a flashlight and your name.
cards.line: Watch meeting at the circle at the end of the street. Bring a flashlight and your name.

cards.mouth: A SIDE QUEST ON THE ROAD
cards.in_the_file: Then we come. And somebody is going to have to say whose ground it is, because we will not be guests forever.
cards.line: Then we come. And somebody is going to have to say whose ground it is, because we will not be guests forever.

cards.in_the_file: Let me see them. Half the days, and half of what the wound takes off him, if you can pay. They walk out with you.
cards.line: Let me see them. Half the days, and half of what the wound takes off him, if you can pay. They walk out with you.

cards.in_the_file: Heart stopped once. Started again out of spite.
cards.line: Heart stopped once. Started again out of spite.

cards.in_the_file: ISO insulin. any kind. it's for my sister. message me, please.
cards.line: ISO insulin. any kind. it's for my sister. message me, please.

cards.in_the_file: Darling. The world ended and you still dress like a parking lot. One coat, Balenciaga, real, from the Forum Shops. Twenty batteries and you live forever.
cards.line: Darling. The world ended and you still dress like a parking lot. One coat, Balenciaga, real, from the Forum Shops. Twenty batteries and you live forever.

cards.in_the_file: {name} showed me how to reload. Like, just now.
cards.line: CHUY showed me how to reload. Like, just now.

cards.in_the_file: {other} drank the last of the water in the night, boss, my share too. I am going to break {other}'s face unless you tell me why I should not.
cards.line: RICO drank the last of the water in the night, boss, my share too. I am going to break RICO's face unless you tell me why I should not.
